title: The Bimini Road Enigma
hook: Why does a mile-long stone road appear beneath the Bahamas?
headline: Mysterious Underwater Road in the Bahamas

beats.label: THE CASE
beats.line: The formation is about 0.8 km (0.5 mi) long, a stone road near Bimini.

beats.label: CLUE 1
beats.line: The formation is about 800 meters long at Bimini.

beats.label: CLUE 2
beats.line: Scientists noted the stones are limestone blocks, some weighing up to two tons.

beats.label: THE TWIST
beats.line: Recent sonar surveys suggest the pattern could be a natural reef, but debate persists.

end.line: What built this mysterious underwater road?

description: Explore the puzzling Bimini Road and the clues that keep scientists divided.

facts.claim: Divers first documented the Bimini Road in May 1968.
The structure is roughly 1,200 meters long and consists of about 30 limestone blocks.
Individual blocks can weigh up to two tons.
A 2012 sonar survey suggested the formation may be a natural reef.
The origin of the road remains debated among archaeologists and marine scientists.
